comment: Milestone-2 gate matrix: prove the axes work end-to-end on one 4090. Not a science run — trajectories/turns are sized for the gate, the real sweep is milestone 3 (configs/sweep.json). fp8_e4m3 without checkpoint scales is a KNOWN-DEGENERATE config on Qwen2.5 (scale=1.0 clips K/V outliers -> token salad); it is kept deliberately as a sensitivity canary: the instrument must score it ~0 while scoring fp16 ~1. NOTE (post-m2): on vLLM 0.19.1 + sm_89 BOTH fp8 formats collapse from turn 0 — a broken kernel path; see runs/m2-smoke and milestone-2.md.
